people.imagined: The Tùng Hạ road at dawn, bareheaded in the cold. His father's axe is across his back, the wolf's bite long healed from his ear, and he is looking at the pines that will not take him.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pine-lined road at dawn, he turns his bareheaded face toward the viewer, an axe haft rising behind his shoulder. Face: most important, the ear: the top third of his left ear is simply gone, a healed, jagged pink-white stump with a clean notch, visible and large in the frame. A broad, sun-dark, square face; heavy straight brows; steady, honest, dark-brown eyes; a wide nose; a firm mouth; a day's stubble. Fine lines crease the skin at his eyes from squinting at snow-glare. Hair: black, thick and cropped short, never covered. Body: huge shoulders and thick neck, a woodcutter's frame, planted. Clothing: the robes of a Golden Core loose cultivator who belongs to no house: a long sleeveless over-robe of deep pine-green brocade with a stitched border of climbing pine boughs in grey-gold thread, over two crossed collars of dark grey silk, wide sleeves bound back at the thick forearms with silver cuffs, a broad sash of dark gold silk hung with a single jade pendant carved as a pine cone. Hands and objects: the long haft of a felling axe of pale pine wood, a wolf's tooth set in it, rising over the right shoulder; his left hand on the sash. Background: dark pines in drifting mist and a low red sun, faint motes of light between the trunks. Light: low gold dawn light from the upper left, a soft silver rim light along the shoulders and the axe haft. Power: a faint green and grey-gold haze of wood and metal qi rises off his shoulders. Expression: a steady, proud, unbowed look with the jaw squared, a man looking at the pines that will not take him.

people.imagined: Noon on the frost coast, in the doorway of a dug-out dead hall. She talks to the lamp more than to her crew; the bronze lamp burns even in full daylight.
people.subject: The moment: in the bright mouth of a ruin she lifts a small green bronze lamp toward her face and murmurs to it, ignoring the viewer. Face: most important, the lit lamp: an old green-bronze temple lamp with a small steady flame burning in full daylight, held up beside her cheek, big in the frame. A small, wrinkled, grey, wind-polished face; narrow, light, shrewd eyes; thin grey brows; a hooked nose; thin lips shaping words. Wind has polished the skin to a thin shine and her nose is red. Hair: iron grey, drawn up under a small silver crown set with a pale blue stone and a hood of white fox fur. Body: small and square, wrapped up and upright. Clothing: the rich robes of a Golden Core elder of the loose cultivators: a long over-robe of deep indigo brocade with a border of embroidered snowflakes and waves in silver thread, three crossed collars of pale blue, grey and white silk showing at the neck, wide sleeves lined with white fur, a sash of silver gauze hung with a jade pendant and a toothed brass seal on a tassel. Hands and objects: the lamp in the left hand; the toothed brass seal in the right, its tassel swinging. Her fingers are stiff and chapped at the knuckles. Background: a blue-white ice wall and a dark opening, mist curling from the dug hall, motes of cold light drifting. Light: pale spirit-light from the upper left, a small warm gold flame, a soft icy rim light on the fur. Power: a thin cold-blue haze of water qi curls about her shoulders, and a faint gold glow rings the flame. Expression: a patient, wary, greedy attention, the shrewd eyes fixed on the lamp's flame as she murmurs.

people.imagined: The Bobtail ridge, mid-winter. The chief sits with an axe hafted in lynx bone across his knees. The lynx cap with its bob tail left on is the camp's badge, and he is thinking of his sworn brother in the south.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a ridge rock, a long-armed old man rests both wrists on the shaft of an axe, and looks at the viewer sideways. Face: most important, the cap: a lynx-skin cap with ear tufts and the short bob of the tail left hanging down the back, grey-spotted fur, big at the top of the frame. A lean, long, hard, weathered face; narrow, pale-grey, calm eyes; thick grey brows; a long hooked nose; a grey stubble; deep lines from nose to mouth. Frost whitens the tips of his brows and stubble. Hair: grey, long, under the cap, tied at the nape with a silver ring. Body: tall, gaunt, long-armed, hunched. Clothing: the robes of a Golden Core chief of a robber camp, rich and wild: a long over-robe of smoke-grey brocade woven with spotted lynx patterns and cloud borders in dark green thread, a thick lynx-fur mantle over the shoulders, three crossed collars of grey, green and white silk, wide sleeves caught at the wrists with silver bands, a sash with a nine-notched iron ring hanging from it beside a jade pendant. Hands and objects: an axe with a pale lynx shin-bone haft across his knees, both hands resting on it. Background: a bare ridge with snow and dark pine in drifting mist, a thin wisp of camp smoke, a few grey crows on a far rock, motes of cold light. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left, a faint rim light along the fur. Power: a slow haze of green and grey-gold wood and metal qi gathers about the axe blade and his shoulders. Expression: a pragmatic, loyal, grim look from under heavy brows, an old chief thinking of his sworn brother in the south.

people.imagined: The ruin crew's ice cut. She holds her bare palm flat on the ice and a hole sinks in with steam; her cheeks bear the old frost-burn from the winter the village tried to cool her in the lake.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on blue ice she presses her bare palm flat against it, steam rising, and looks up. Face: most important, the frost-burn marks: pale waxy blotches on both cheeks, shiny and mottled, in contrast to flushed red lips and warm skin, and the steam rising from her hand. A thin, narrow, pale-pink face; bright, hot, hazel eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; chapped lips parted. Melt-water beads on her lashes. Hair: dark brown, cut short at the jaw, uneven and slightly singed at the ends, with a single small copper hairpin and a ribbon of faded orange silk. Body: thin, wiry, crouched, shoulders narrow and knees drawn tight under her. Clothing: a young cultivator's simple graceful silk: a soft cream under-robe with two crossed collars, over it a short robe of pale russet gauze with wide sleeves pushed to the elbow and a narrow hem embroidered with tiny flames in orange thread, a plain rust-red sash; round her neck a small glass bead on a cord that glows orange. Hands and objects: the bare, chapped, red hand on the ice with steam and a round melted hole beneath it; beside her a small copper brazier with glowing coals. Background: a wall of blue ice, a dug passage fading into mist, drifting motes of frost-light. Light: orange glow from the brazier and bead on the lower right, cold moonlit blue from the upper left, a soft rim light on her wet lashes. Power: a clear hot red-orange wisp of fire qi curls up from the hand. Expression: an impatient, brave, trusting look, the hot hazel eyes bright and the chapped lips parted.

people.imagined: The caravan yard at Tùng Hạ Thị, early. She is tall, and the staff is worn white at the grip; she tests the bow's string with a thumb. The boy she taught is somewhere in the pines.
people.subject: The moment: standing tall in a caravan yard at first light, she tests the string of a long bow with her thumb while looking down at the viewer. Face: most important, the white staff and the bow: a long bow of pale yellow wood in her left hand with the string drawn across her thumb, and a staff worn white at the grip leaning against her shoulder. A long, handsome, angular face; high cheekbones; sharp grey eyes under straight brows; a straight nose; a stern mouth; a few fine lines. Hair: black streaked grey, in a long braid pinned round the head with two silver hairpins. Body: tall, strong, long-limbed, rangy, her weight on her left leg, one shoulder lower, completely at ease. Clothing: the travelling robes of a Foundation Establishment guard: a long over-robe of deep forest-green silk with a high crossed collar and a border of embroidered willow leaves in pale gold thread, a second collar of cream gauze beneath, narrow sleeves bound at the wrists with silver cuffs so the string hand is free, a sash of dark green silk hung with a small jade pendant; a quiver of grey-fletched arrows on her back with tassels of green silk. Hands and objects: the bow, its string a plain twisted gut with a bone nock; the staff with a braided grip band. Background: wagons and mules, pale pine-board gates dissolving in morning mist, motes of dust-light. Light: pale spirit-light of first dawn from the upper left, a silver glint on the arrow tips. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi curls along the bow's limb. Expression: a cool, appraising look down at the viewer, brows level, the mouth firm and stubborn, her eyes measuring them as she tests the string.

people.imagined: The river mouth at midnight. He poles without a lantern and has never been seen to hurry; he remembers no one's face, as the trade requires.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a narrow boat at night poling slowly, he turns his hooded face toward the viewer without any expression. Face: most important, the reed cape: a thick shaggy rain cape of dried grey-brown reeds covering his shoulders and back like a haystack, with a wide reed hat shading his face. A long, stooped, plain, pale face half in shadow; deep-set, dull, grey eyes with no curiosity; thin grey brows; a flat nose; a closed, slack mouth; grey stubble. Hair: grey under the hat, tied up with a plain jade-green ribbon. Body: tall, stooped, slow, bending slightly at the waist at each push of the pole, long arms hanging below the cape. Clothing: beneath the reed cape the robes of a quiet Foundation Establishment ferryman: a long over-robe of dark slate-blue gauze with wide sleeves, a border of faint embroidered ripples in silver thread, two crossed collars of grey and pale blue silk, a sash of grey silk with a single small jade pendant shaped like a fish; no lantern anywhere. Hands and objects: a long pole of dark wet wood held in both hands; a dark, narrow boat with a flat grey stern nearly level with the water. Background: a black river, grey reeds, a pale moon in drifting mist, faint motes of light on the water. Light: pale blue moonlight from the upper left and nothing else; only the water carries light, in a thin ripple edge, and his eyes are two dull points in the hat's shadow. Power: a faint cold-blue shimmer of water qi runs along the pole and the ripples. Expression: a blank, calm face with half-lidded eyes and no expression at all, nothing in it to remember.

people.imagined: The dice house on the Hàn Tân quay, lamplit. She counts debts and gossip. A pearl in each ear, one real and one glass, and she will not say which.
people.subject: The moment: behind a dice table she tilts her head to show one ear, smiling kindly. Face: most important, the earrings: one large round pearl on a gold wire in each ear, and they differ by a faint hair's breadth in gloss, one bright and creamy, one slightly glassy and too perfect. A plump, soft, round, pink face with double chins; small, shrewd, bright eyes sunk in creases; thin plucked brows; a small nose; a small rosebud smile. Rouge sits in neat circles on both cheeks and her chins quiver as she tilts her head. Hair: white and grey, in a high round coil held by a jade pin and a gold comb. Body: round, comfortable, short, with ring-laden hands. Clothing: the rich robes of a Foundation Establishment woman of means: a long over-robe of plum-purple brocade with wide sleeves and a collar embroidered with coins and peony blossoms in gold thread, a pale blue gauze shawl over the shoulders, a second and third collar of cream and rose silk, a necklace of coral beads and a jade pendant on a gold tassel, several gold rings. Hands and objects: a pair of small ivory dice cupped in her hand; a tray of coins; a gold bracelet slides down her wrist. Background: a warm dim gaming room hung with silk lamps, shadows of men leaning, drifting motes of lamp-light. Light: warm lamplight from the lower right, cool spirit-light from the upper left, a soft pearly rim light along the cheek. Power: a faint blue sheen of water qi glimmers in the pearls. Expression: a motherly, soft, rosebud smile with shrewd eyes that stay cold, a woman who will not say which pearl is real.

people.imagined: A desert road at noon, the sand-worn face of a man who belongs to neither side. A sabre on each hip, one from his father's people, one from his mother's. He sits in the saddle without strain.
people.subject: The moment: on a camel in desert wind he looks steadily at the viewer, a sabre at each hip. Face: most important, the two sabres: a curved sabre with a red silk-bound grip on his right hip and a straight-backed sabre with a black silk-bound grip on his left, both fully visible, different in length. A long, lean, brown face worn smooth as stone by sand; narrow, pale hazel eyes in permanent squint; thin dark brows; a straight nose; a calm, level mouth; a short grey-black beard. Fine sand has settled into every line of his face. Hair: black, under a pale gold-cream silk head-cloth wound round the head and neck, held by a small silver clasp. Body: wiry, bow-legged, easy in the saddle. Clothing: the flowing desert robes of a Foundation Establishment sabre: a long over-robe of sand-gold gauze with a high crossed collar and a border of embroidered dune-ripples and flames in dark red thread, a second collar of ivory silk, wide sleeves tied back at the wrist, a short vest of deep indigo brocade, a red silk sash hung with a jade pendant and tassel, a long scarf of indigo gauze streaming in the wind. Hands and objects: the reins in one hand; the other loosely on the thigh. Background: bright sand dunes under a pale blue sky, a smear of heat, a line of small dark camels crawling over a far dune, drifting motes of golden dust. Light: bright pale light from the upper left, a soft gold rim light along the scarf. Power: a faint earth-gold and red haze of earth and fire qi lifts with the dust around his shoulders. Expression: a temperate, just, brave stillness, the squinting eyes calm and the mouth level, a man who belongs to neither side and sits the saddle without strain.

people.imagined: The ice market at Quy Điểu Trấn. He sells live beasts and cores, and the lynx at his heel watches the crowd for him. The string of wolf teeth lies in his pocket now, because he no longer wears it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a market on ice, he looks sidelong with narrowed eyes, a grey lynx at his boot. Face: most important, the lynx: a grey spirit lynx with black ear tufts, sitting at his left heel and staring at the viewer, large in the frame. A lean, hard, handsome face with sharp cheekbones; cold, pale green eyes; thin straight brows; a narrow nose; thin lips set in a calculating line; a trimmed pale beard. Hair: sandy-brown, tied back with a silver ring, under a white fox-fur hood. Body: lean, wiry, standing alert, his back very straight and his elbows close, like a man ready to move at once. Clothing: the robes of a Foundation Establishment beast hunter who sells well: a long over-robe of pale grey brocade with a crossed collar, a border of embroidered fox-tails and snow-crystals in silver thread, two inner collars of white and sea-green silk, a white fox-fur cape with the tails hanging, wide sleeves caught with silver bands, a sash of linked bone beads and jade with a pocket from which a few ivory teeth poke out. Hands and objects: one hand holding a short braided lead wound twice round his wrist; the other on the hilt of a short curved skinning knife with a bone grip. Background: an ice market of stalls and cages dissolving into pale mist and a grey sky, motes of frost-light. Light: cold spirit-light from the upper left, the white fur glowing bluish in the shade and the lynx's tufted ears tipped by sharp light. Power: a thin green wisp of wood qi coils from the lynx to his hand. Expression: narrowed, sidelong eyes with a cruel little curl of the lip and a suspicious tilt of the head, greed and mistrust in one hard look.

people.imagined: Stairs to a ruin, a smile and two map cases. He stops on every stair to catch his breath, and his clients carry the cases on. The case he never opens hangs on the left shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: pausing on a stone stair, smiling warmly at the viewer, one hand on his chest. Face: most important, the two map cases: two long map cases of lacquered leather, one hanging on each shoulder, one bright and new and one dark, tied shut with a cord, both visible. A round, gentle, pleasant face with soft cheeks; warm brown eyes crinkled; thin neat brows; a small nose; a wide, easy smile; ink-stained fingers. Hair: black, thinning, in a tidy topknot with a plain jade pin. Body: soft, middling height, slightly out of breath, chest rising and falling, knees a little bent, a little sweat shining on his temple. Clothing: the robes of a Luyện Khí scholar-guide: a long, simple, graceful robe of pale grey silk with wide sleeves and two crossed collars of grey and white, tidy and a little dusty at the hem, a thin border of embroidered mountain ridges in silver-grey thread, a black silk cord sash with a small jade pendant, ink on every fingertip. Hands and objects: the left hand on the chest; the right hand holding a folding fan of plain paper with only a faint brush wash of grey hills; the black cord-tied map case hangs on his left. Background: a stone stair rising into hanging mist, a half-hidden ruin gate, drifting motes of pale light. Light: soft misty spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle white rim light on the cheek. Power: a barely visible grey-green wisp of wood and metal qi curls round the fan. Expression: deceitful, friendly, easy: a warm smile that gives away nothing.

people.imagined: The fish ponds of Ngư Đàm Thôn at dusk. She kneels at the pond edge, her dead husband's undyed sash tied round her waist, her hand in the water. Her daughter is not to sit the Frost Test.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a pond edge she lifts a wet hand from the water and looks at the viewer with set jaw. Face: most important, the sash and the silver: an undyed pale sash tied round her waist, plain and unadorned against her dark robe, and fish-scale silver glittering along both sleeves. A small, brown, lined face; dark, steady, stubborn eyes; thick straight brows; a small nose; a firm, small mouth. Hair: black with grey, in a tight bun under a faded blue silk kerchief with a single silver pin. Body: small, sturdy, kneeling upright and square on a flat stone, knees apart, back straight, her wet sleeve dark to the elbow. Clothing: a Luyện Khí widow's modest, clean silk: a long robe of deep blue silk with two crossed collars, wide sleeves silvered with fish scales, a border of small embroidered waves in pale blue thread, a long grey skirt, and the pale undyed mourning sash. Hands and objects: a wet hand held up, dripping; four silver minnows in a small reed basket beside her, the pond water running from her fingers in a bright thread. Background: a still dark pond, reeds, an orange dusk sky, faint motes of light over the water. Light: low orange dusk light from the upper left glowing on the water and her damp hair, a soft silver rim light, the silver on her sleeves sparkling. Power: a faint blue wisp of water qi rises from the pond round her wrist. Expression: a set, stubborn jaw and wet, steady eyes on the viewer, tenderness showing at the edges of a fierce, protective face.

people.imagined: Against a dead wall in a ruin, his head tilted like a dog's, a silk strip on his wrist that stirs when nothing else does. The draught of a buried hall comes through the rock.
people.subject: The moment: pressed close to a stone wall he tilts his head sideways, listening, eyes unfocused. Face: most important, the silk strip: a thin pale-green silk strip tied round his left wrist, floating out sideways in the still air while everything else hangs limp, in the foreground. A long, thin, boyish face; large pale eyes with a faint silver sheen; thin arched brows; a long nose; a half-open mouth. His lashes are long and nearly white and a thin pulse beats at his temple. Hair: light brown, long and untidy, blown up and sideways at one side only, held by a plain silver pin. Body: tall, gangly, long-necked, leaning, shoulders narrow and slightly hunched. Clothing: a young Luyện Khí cultivator's graceful silk: a long robe of pale grey-blue gauze with two crossed collars of white and sage, long wide sleeves that hang still, a border of embroidered drifting clouds in silver thread, a plain silver-grey sash with a small jade pendant shaped like a feather. Hands and objects: the left hand flat on the stone, the wrist strip floating out a hand long in the colour of young leaves, his long pale fingers spread against the stone. Background: a dark wet stone wall, a dim ruin, dust motes drifting sideways in the unseen draught. Light: dim cool spirit-light from the upper left, a faint pale rim light on the hair. Power: a faint pale-silver haze of wind qi stirs the strip and his hair. Expression: an uncanny, curious, unfocused attention, the half-open mouth slack and the pale eyes unseeing.

people.imagined: A ridge camp in the mist. He is named for the three axe-scars across his cheek. He stares at the viewer with the stare of a man who has taught a village the new rate.
people.subject: The moment: in a misty camp he stands close to the viewer and stares, head tilted slightly forward. Face: most important, the three scars: three parallel pale white scars slanting across the left cheek from the cheekbone down to the jaw, thick and ridged, large and sharp in the frame. A heavy, square, tanned face; hard, dark, flat eyes; thick black brows; a broken nose; a thick lip curled in a faint sneer; a short black beard. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot with a black cord and an iron hairpin. Body: thick, strong, broad-shouldered, a stonecutter's forearms, his chest pushed forward and his chin lowered, as if about to move on the viewer. Clothing: the robes of a Foundation Establishment robber lieutenant, severe and rich: a long over-robe of dark brown brocade with iron-grey cloud borders and a high fur collar, a second collar of black silk, sleeves bound at the wrists with studded silver bands, a wide dark sash hung with a jade pendant and a short bearded axe. Hands and objects: the short axe held loosely down at his side in the right hand, a small chip on its edge and a strip of red silk wound round the haft above his fist; the knuckles of that hand flat and broken. Background: grey mist, black pine trunks, a smoky fire behind him, motes of ember. Light: cold grey spirit-light from the upper left, a dull orange glow from the fire, the scars alone shining like white tape across his dark cheek. Power: a faint green haze of wood qi hangs at the axe edge. Expression: a hard, close stare with the head tipped forward, brows low, the scarred cheek tight and the mouth impatient and without mercy.

people.imagined: The Bobtail ridge, at the milestone. He has trimmed his own hair with a knife and leaves a bowl of rice each month; he wonders if the mist would take him as it took the others.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a stone milestone he sets down a small rice bowl and glances back with a worried face. Face: most important, the ears and the bowl-cut: large ears sticking straight out from the head like open doors, and an uneven bowl-shaped haircut, chopped straight across with a knife. A thin, young, boyish, nervous face; large dark brown eyes; thin, worried brows; a small nose; a small mouth tight. His ears are pink at the tips and a tiny freckle sits on his lip. Hair: dull black, bowl-cut, uneven. Body: thin, gangly, crouching with his knees apart and his elbows resting on them, poised to run. Clothing: a young Luyện Khí robber's simple graceful silk, a little too big for him: a long robe of undyed brown-grey silk with two crossed collars and sleeves folded back at the wrists, a plain border of small embroidered pine-needles in dark green thread, a rope-twist sash with a short knife on a cord, a grey silk scarf, and at the shoulder a strip of lynx fur as the camp's badge. Hands and objects: a small chipped bowl of white rice placed with its grains in a tidy mound; the other hand on the milestone, a rough grey knee-high pillar, mossy, with a hollow on top where an older bowl has left a ring; his knife blade shorter than his hand. Background: a mossy stone marker, misty trees fading to gloom, faint motes of light. Light: cool grey spirit-light from the upper left, the mist making his ears glow slightly pink at their edges. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi hovers over the rice bowl. Expression: a humble, anxious, wary look glancing back, a boy who wishes he could leave and does not.

people.imagined: A river crossing at night with bales of hemp. He shorts each bale by a fifth. Hemp fibre has greyed his stubble, and rope burns circle both wrists like bracelets.
people.subject: The moment: crouched over a bale in the dark, he looks up with a calm, almost bored smile. Face: most important, the wrists: a ring of red-brown rope-burn scar circling each wrist like a bracelet, held on the bale in the foreground, and grey hemp fibres in the stubble of his chin. A narrow, calm, pale-brown face; heavy-lidded, quiet, grey eyes; thin, straight brows; a long nose; a thin, closed, faintly smiling mouth. Faint grey dust frosts his lashes. Hair: dark brown, tied at the nape with a silver cord, fibres caught in it. Body: lean, wiry, crouched with his weight low and his shoulders loose like a man ready to slip away. Clothing: the robes of a Foundation Establishment river trader who does well: a long over-robe of dark midnight-blue silk with two crossed collars of slate and white, tightly stitched, wide sleeves rolled to the forearm to show the scars, a border of embroidered rope-knots and ripples in silver thread, a belt of dark silk hung with coils of silver cord and a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: a heavy bale of pale hemp under his hands, tied with three loops of cord, one corner split open to show pale grey-gold fibres; a short hooked knife lies on his knee. Background: a dark river bank, a shadowy boat, a faint lantern far off in drifting mist, motes of light. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, a cold line of light running along the cord and the stubble on his chin. Power: a faint cold-blue wisp of water qi coils over the bale. Expression: a calm, almost bored, thin smile with heavy-lidded eyes, a man who shorts every bale by a fifth and is not troubled by it.

people.imagined: A river sandbank. She swirls the pan and her one gold tooth catches light; she says she found it. Her hands are bleached wrinkled, and her husband's ledger sits in the false bottom of the pan.
people.subject: The moment: in a shallow river she holds a wide flat wooden pan at her waist, smiling slightly as she swirls it. Face: most important, the hands and the tooth: both hands bleached white and wrinkled like a drowned person's, gripping the rim of the pan in the foreground, and a single gold tooth glinting in a half-smile. A weathered, round, brown face; narrow bright black eyes; thin brows; a flat nose; a mouth with one gold tooth. Hair: grey-black, in a tight bun under a bleached silk cloth with a silver pin. Body: short, solid, standing calf-deep, feet planted wide in the stream, knees slightly bent, water swirling round her calves. Clothing: a Luyện Khí river-woman's graceful, clean silk: a robe of soft brown-gold silk with two crossed collars and sleeves rolled, a wet blue gauze skirt tucked up at the knee, a border of embroidered river waves in pale thread, a sash of blue silk, a necklace of small pale shells and one jade bead. Hands and objects: a wooden gold-washing pan with a thin film of water and dark sand and three tiny bright flecks of gold; a second pan hangs from her sash on a cord, its false bottom just visible as a seam. Background: a sunlit river and gravel bank in a soft haze, glittering motes of water-light. Light: bright clear spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glint of water glitter along her cheek and on the gold tooth, like a small star in her mouth. Power: a faint blue wisp of water qi curls up from the pan. Expression: a slight, secret smile with cautious, pale-lidded eyes, the gold tooth just showing and her glance sliding to the pan.

people.imagined: A frost-coast quay, with ice-fish crates. His left eye wanders when he lies, which is often; he smells of brine and does not meet the eye.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a crate of ice-fish he gives the viewer a flat, reasonable smile, the left eye drifting. Face: most important, the wandering eye: the left eye turned noticeably outward and upward, looking off to the side while the right eye stares directly at the viewer, plainly mismatched. A wide, pale, fleshy, damp face; small, pale-blue eyes; sparse light brows; a thick nose; thin lips; stubble. Fine sweat beads his upper lip even in the cold. Hair: sparse grey-brown strands slicked across the scalp under a small silver-banded cap of dark fur. Body: stout, thick, with a stoop, his belly resting on the edge of the crate, his stance slumped, one hip cocked. Clothing: the robes of a prosperous Foundation Establishment fence: a long over-robe of dark sea-green silk shining with brine like a glaze, two crossed collars of grey and cream, wide sleeves with a border of embroidered fish scales and waves in pale silver thread, a silk sash tied in a fat knot and hung with a jade pendant carved as a carp. Hands and objects: a silver ice-fish held by the tail in one hand, its swollen belly stitched shut with black thread; a flat crate behind him stamped with a plain painted circle, nothing written; his fingers thick and short, the nails pale with brine. Background: a grey quay, stacked crates, boats, thin mist, motes of cold light. Light: cold spirit-light from the upper left, a faint blue rim light along the wet silk. Power: a faint blue haze of water qi clings to the fish. Expression: a flat, reasonable, callous smile with one eye wandering off to the side, a man who does not meet your gaze when he lies.

people.imagined: The Pavilion's dead hall, cutting ice. He rubs a blue-grey frostbitten ear when he thinks, three solstice nights spent on the mere behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in an ice passage with a long ice saw over one shoulder he rubs his right ear thoughtfully. Face: most important, the ear: the right ear is blue-grey and waxy with an old frostbite patch, big and clear as his hand rubs it. A broad, patient, dark, weathered face; thick brows; small, calm, grey eyes; a flat nose; a stubborn mouth; stubble. Hair: black, short, a knitted silk cap hanging off. Body: huge shoulders broad as a door, thick neck, standing wide, his arms hanging slightly out from his sides from the width of his back. Clothing: a Luyện Khí ice-cutter's simple graceful silk, plain and clean: a long robe of deep slate-blue silk with two crossed collars of grey and white, wide sleeves rolled back to the elbow, a quilted vest of dark blue brocade, a border of small embroidered snowflakes in pale thread, a silk rope sash tied in a heavy knot with a spare coil at the hip. Hands and objects: a long toothed ice saw over the left shoulder, with big triangular teeth and a wooden crossbar handle. Background: a blue ice wall lit from within, a hanging lamp, mist drifting along the passage, motes of frost-light. Light: cold blue spirit-light from the upper left, a faint yellow lamp casting a glint along the saw teeth and the frost patch on his ear. Power: a faint blue wisp of water qi drifts from his breath. Expression: a slow, thoughtful frown with the head slightly bowed, patient stubborn eyes and a humble, quiet mouth.

people.imagined: A dice house, late. He chews his thumbnail; the candle at his table gutters whatever the draught. He has lost for forty years and still hopes.
people.subject: The moment: at a dice table he chews the thumbnail of his raised right hand and looks at the viewer with pleading eyes. Face: most important, the guttering candle: a short thick candle on the table in front of him with a tall flame leaning sharply to one side and dripping wax, though other candles burn straight, in the foreground. A soft, round, flushed face with loose cheeks; damp, wide, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short nose; a trembling mouth. Hair: thin, grey-brown, combed over and held with a tarnished silver pin. Body: soft and round, hunched, his shoulders slumped forward, his belly in his lap, his left hand drumming on the table edge. Clothing: a Luyện Khí gambler's once-fine silk, rumpled but clean: a long robe of plum silk with two crossed collars of rose and cream, stained here and there with wine at the wide sleeves, a border of embroidered coins and dice in faded gold thread, a loose sash with a lucky coin on a string at the neck beside a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: the chewed thumb; a small cup of dice; two small bone dice, a few lonely copper coins, and a spilled cup of wine on the table, the guttering flame dripping a long white tongue of wax. Background: a dim dice house of silk lamps, a green felt table, blurred shapes of men, drifting motes of lamplight. Light: warm yellow from the candle at the lower right flickering on his damp cheeks and the sweat on his lip, cool spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi stirs oddly round the leaning flame. Expression: indulgent, anxious, hopeful: a man who has lost for forty years and still hopes.

people.imagined: A reed-lined river in grey light. She stands in the ferry's bow, barefoot, braid tied with a fish-hook, remembering faces that were told to be forgotten.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot in a narrow boat's bow, a pole in her hands, she looks over her shoulder with a frown of effort. Face: most important, the fish-hook: a small bright fish-hook tying off the end of her long braid, dangling over her shoulder in the foreground. A small, round, reed-tanned face; large, clear, light-brown eyes; thin straight brows; a short nose; a determined mouth. A few water drops cling to her lashes. Hair: dark brown, in a long braid tied with a hook, strands of damp hair sticking to her neck. Body: slim, long-legged, balanced, feet one before the other on the wet planks, knees bent to the boat's sway. Clothing: a young Luyện Khí ferry girl's simple, clean silk: a short robe of soft river-blue silk with two crossed collars of white and sky-blue and wide sleeves, a border of tiny embroidered reeds in silver thread, trousers of pale blue gauze rolled to the knee, a rope-twist sash with a small jade pendant, bare arms and feet. Hands and objects: a long pole of pale wood with a notched grip in both hands; a clay lamp-cup at her feet with a hairline crack and a thumbprint of soot, unlit. Background: tall reeds, a still river, drifting mist, faint motes of light on the water. Light: soft grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left throwing pale reflections up under her chin. Power: a faint blue wisp of water qi ripples round the pole. Expression: a brave, honest, haunted look, the clear eyes fixed on the far bank as if reading faces she was told to forget.

people.imagined: The apes' ridge, ginseng dug from the soil. Seamed like the roots she sells, with soil under every nail. She holds up one and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in forest earth she holds up a freshly dug forked ginseng root in a dirt-black hand. Face: most important, the seamed face: skin deeply lined all over in tight brown creases like the wrinkles of a dried root, and black soil packed under every nail on the held-up hand. A small, brown, deeply creased face; small, dark, wary eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a tight line of a mouth. Dirt is ground into the creases beside her nose and mouth. Hair: grey and wiry, in a tight bun under a faded green silk cloth with a bone pin. Body: small, bent, tough, her back bowed and her shoulders pulled forward, the posture of a person always bending to the ground. Clothing: a Luyện Khí herb-gatherer's plain but graceful silk, clean on the surface though earth-dark at the knees: a long robe of soft brown silk with two crossed collars of moss green and cream, wide sleeves tied back, a border of small embroidered ginseng leaves in pale green thread, a sash of green cord hung with a small bone digging-tool and a jade bead. Hands and objects: a pale forked ginseng root with a long body, three fingers and a hair-fine beard in the right hand; a short bone spade in the left; a sack beside her; a few red berries scattered nearby; her nails black-rimmed and her wrist bones standing out. Background: dark moss and ferns in grey mist, drifting motes of green light. Light: dim green spirit-light from the upper left, a thread of mist crossing behind her head and a soft rim light on the root. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi rises from the root. Expression: a flat, wary, diligent stillness, the small dark eyes not meeting yours, a woman who holds up the root and says nothing.

people.imagined: The Loose Table under the pines, the stove going. She tucks a fresh pine needle behind her ear without noticing, and the foundation pills in the jar behind her come with no promise.
people.subject: The moment: behind a counter she ladles wine from a jar, beaming, a green pine needle tucked behind her right ear. Face: most important, the pine needle: a long green pine needle tucked behind her ear, bright against grey hair, and a face flushed red from the stove. A round, flushed, cheerful face with dimples; warm, bright, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short nose; a big smile. Hair: grey, in a loose bun with loose curls, held by a carved jade pin. Body: round, strong, comfortable, one hip against the counter, her shoulders shaking as she laughs. Clothing: a Luyện Khí tavern-keeper's graceful, warm silk: a long robe of dark red silk with two crossed collars of cream and rose, wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, a border of embroidered pine sprigs and cups in gold thread, a pale gauze overskirt, a green silk sash with a ring of small keys and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a wooden ladle dripping a thin dark ribbon of wine back into a jar; behind her a plank of small wax-sealed clay jars, all identical, one set apart. Background: a wooden counter, a stove with glowing coals, hanging jugs and lanterns, a long table, drifting motes of warm light. Light: warm orange from the stove at the lower right deepening the red of her cheeks and lighting the steam, cool spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi and a warm red glimmer rise with the steam. Expression: gregarious, generous, pragmatic: the open smile of a woman who hears everyone's secrets and keeps them.

people.imagined: A desert caravan at night; she sets out to sit the solstice test uninvited. Hair so black it looks wet; she does not blink in the wind.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a camel's pack in blowing sand, she looks straight ahead without blinking. Face: most important, the hair and the eyes: hair so black it gleams like wet ink, and wide dark eyes fixed open, unblinking in the wind. A small, fine, pale-gold face with a clear forehead; straight black brows; a small straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a sheen of dew-like frost on her lashes. Hair: pure glossy black, long and straight, blowing sideways, with a single silver hairpin shaped like a drop of water. Body: slight, sitting very straight, knees together and her back as straight as a post, the camel's hump swaying behind her. Clothing: a young Luyện Khí girl's modest, graceful silk: a clean pale-blue gauze robe with two crossed collars of white and sky-blue and a border of embroidered waves in silver thread, a sand-gold travelling cloak of light silk over it, a veil at the neck, a plain pale sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: a small jade-green water gourd in her lap on a braided green cord, a faint dew of moisture clinging to its side despite the dry air; her hands folded. Background: a dark blue desert night with stars and wind-driven sand, motes of silver light. Light: pale starlight and moonlight from the upper left, fine sand streaking past, the only thing not blurred the glimmer on her hair and a soft silver rim light. Power: a clear faint blue shimmer of water qi, a surprising frost, gathers around her. Expression: ambitious, brave, set: a girl riding alone to a test she was not invited to.

people.imagined: The bell foundry at Đà Linh Trấn. Brass dust on his forearms; he tilts his head so the half-deaf ear faces the clanging. He left the riders the opposite way to his grandmother's brother.
people.subject: The moment: in a foundry he holds a small camel bell up near his half-deaf ear and shakes it lazily, smiling. Face: most important, the brass dust: forearms and hands glittering with gold-brass dust, held up at the bell in the foreground. A broad, easy, brown face with a lazy half-smile; calm brown eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; sunburnt cheeks. Hair: black, tied in a short tail with a silk ribbon; one ear covered. Body: broad, relaxed, a little round, his weight on one hip, belly soft over the sash, his head tilted toward the good ear. Clothing: a Luyện Khí outer rider turned bell-founder, in simple graceful silk: a long robe of sand-coloured silk with two crossed collars of cream and gold, sleeves rolled back from the forearms, a border of embroidered sand-ripples and bells in ochre thread, a wide sash of deep red silk, a jade bead on a cord. Hands and objects: a small brass camel bell the size of a plum, with a clapper of black iron, in his palm; a row of six larger bells hanging from a hook, each a slightly different shade of gold; past the left shoulder rises the tan-corded hilt of a plain narrow straight sword slung on the back, its ochre-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade plain grey steel. Background: a foundry with a small furnace glowing orange and a rack of moulds, drifting motes of golden dust. Light: orange from the furnace on the right making the brass dust on his forearm sparkle like sequins, soft spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a faint earth-yellow and red wisp of earth and fire qi curls up from the furnace to the bell. Expression: a slow, easy grin, the eyes crinkled half shut, head cocked to catch the bell's note: a man at rest who wants to be nowhere else.

people.imagined: A snowed-in trapper's hut. The sables have long been trapped out, yet he runs his lines. He raises his gloves, fingers worn through, to warm them at the stove.
people.subject: The moment: seated by a stove he holds up both hands in dark sable gloves toward the heat, glancing at the viewer. Face: most important, the nose and the gloves: a nose that has been broken twice, crooked and swollen and red with cold, and a pair of dark sable gloves with all the fingertips worn through, pink fingers poking out. A long, weathered, bony face; pale, kind, tired eyes; thick grey brows; a grey stubble; a sunken mouth. Frost has melted in drops along his brows. Hair: white, thin, under a fur hat with ear flaps tied with a silver cord; a few white strands curl out. Body: tall, thin, stooped, sitting with his shoulders hunched to his ears and his knees apart, the very picture of a man warming through. Clothing: a Luyện Khí hermit-trapper's plain, clean, graceful silk: a long robe of deep brown silk with two crossed collars of grey and cream, trimmed with a soft sable edge, a border of embroidered snow-tracks in silver thread, wide sleeves, a sash with a small jade pendant and a skinning knife, a heavy scarf of grey silk. Hands and objects: the open gloves; behind him on the wall a string of old rusted traps with a single grey sable pelt, flat and worn; a mug of black tea on the stove's edge. Background: a dim wooden hut, a small iron stove glowing, hanging pelts, drifting motes of ember. Light: warm orange from the stove on the right warming his crooked nose, cold spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a faint blue wisp of water qi drifts up with the steam. Expression: a tired, generous, reclusive gentleness, the pale eyes soft on the stove's glow, a trapper who still runs his lines.

people.imagined: The edge of the mirror forest at evening. He walks lost travellers out by the light, a white streak in his black hair that does not melt even by a fire.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a dark forest at dusk, a hand lifted to guide someone behind him, he looks back calmly. Face: most important, the white streak: a broad frost-white streak running back from his left temple through the black hair, with fine rime on it, shining. A calm, long, pale-bronze face; level dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, quiet mouth. A faint fog of breath hangs before his mouth. Hair: black and straight, falling loose to the shoulders and parted in the middle, a thin silver band across the brow. Body: lean, tall, steady, one foot forward, shoulders open, the easy stance of someone used to walking at night. Clothing: a young Luyện Khí guide's graceful silk, well cut: a long robe of dark blue-grey silk with two crossed collars of silver-grey and white, a soft fur edge at the collar, wide sleeves closed at the cuffs with small horn clasps, a border of embroidered frost-ferns in silver thread, a sash with a small jade pendant and a coil of pale silk cord. Hands and objects: the lifted hand; a pale small lantern of glass the size of a pear, burning with a cold white flame that casts no heat, at his belt. Background: dark pines and a pale evening glow behind him, faint mist, motes of white light. Light: pale evening spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver gleam on the white streak, rime on the lantern glass, the forest behind him nearly black. Power: a faint blue-white wisp of frost qi trails from the lantern. Expression: a calm, quiet, patient steadiness, the level eyes unhurried, a man who has walked many travellers out of the dark.

people.imagined: A moonstone shaft. He rolls up a sleeve and the scar branches up his arm like a fern; the vein's lightning ran there, and woke Thunder in him at nine.
people.subject: The moment: in a mine shaft he rolls up his right sleeve and holds the arm out to the viewer, jaw set. Face: most important, the scar: a pale, branching, silver-pink scar like a fern or river delta, spreading up the right arm from the wrist to the shoulder, large across the frame. A square, strong, dust-pale face; hard, bright, dark eyes; thick, straight brows; a strong nose; a stubborn mouth; a faint stubble. Hair: black, short, dusted with pale grit. Body: strong, wide-shouldered, his right shoulder a little lower than his left, the arm held a bit stiffly out from the body. Clothing: a Luyện Khí moonstone miner's graceful silk: a long robe of dust-grey silk with two crossed collars of pale grey and white, one wide sleeve rolled high and the other bound at the wrist with a silver band, a border of embroidered crescent moons and lightning-forks in pale silver thread, a dark sash with a small pick and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: the scarred arm held out; in the left hand a lump of pale moonstone the size of a duck egg, pearly white, glowing faintly from within; the scar darker at its branching tips. Background: a shaft framed in dark timber, the pale gleam of moonstone veins in the rock, drifting motes of white light. Light: cold white spirit-light from the upper left, a faint crackle of pale blue-white along the scar, as if the vein were still passing. Power: a faint violet-white flicker of thunder qi runs along the scar. Expression: brave, impatient, proud: a man who shows his scar to the world as a badge.

people.imagined: The high ice above a hermitage gate, midsummer. Windburnt cheeks, her sleeves yellowed with snow-lotus pollen, she lifts a white bloom in a gloved hand.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a steep ice slope she holds up a snow-lotus bloom and smiles into the wind. Face: most important, the pink cheeks and the yellow sleeves: both cheeks bright pink and windburnt, and both sleeves stained bright yellow with pollen, in the foreground. A round, warm, kind face; clear, light, brown eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a wide, calm smile. Hair: brown, in two braids wound up under a white fleece cap with a silver pin. Body: sturdy, strong shoulders, leaning into the wind, knees bent on the steep slope, her robe flapping behind. Clothing: a Luyện Khí gatherer's simple graceful silk: a long robe of pale blue quilted silk with two crossed collars of white and ice-blue, wide sleeves stained yellow with pollen, a border of embroidered snow-lotus petals in silver thread, a sash of grey silk with a small jade pendant, a rope harness at the waist tied to a peg in the ice. Hands and objects: a white, many-petalled snow-lotus with twelve petals and a gold centre dusted with yellow pollen in the right hand; a small ice axe in the left. Background: a white ice slope, blue shadows, a distant roof in drifting mist, motes of pale light. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left giving her cheeks a rosy glow and the flower a faint pearly shine, a soft white rim light. Power: a faint blue-white wisp of water qi drifts from the bloom. Expression: a calm, warm smile into the wind, windburnt cheeks lifted and eyes soft and generous.

people.imagined: A snow-jade mine. Her lashes are dusted pale with jade grit; she squints at a lamp as at a sun. She failed the Level Beam by five.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim mine she squints at a held-up lamp, her face turned half away. Face: most important, the lashes: both eyelashes and brows thickly dusted pale green-white with jade grit so her eyes look frosted, and her eyes squeezed nearly shut against the lamp. A thin, pale, serious face; fine features; a small straight nose; a patient, humble mouth. Hair: black, in a plain braid under a grey silk cap with a single jade pin. Body: slight, upright, elbows tight to her sides, shoulders narrow, standing as still as a post. Clothing: a young Luyện Khí miner's simple graceful silk, dusted pale: a long robe of grey-green silk with two crossed collars of sage and white, sleeves tied back, a border of embroidered light-rays in pale gold thread, a plain sash with a small pouch of pale grit and a jade bead. Hands and objects: a miner's oil lamp held at arm's length, its chimney soot-stained at the top; in the other hand a lump of pale translucent snow-jade the size of a thumb, glowing a faint cool green. Background: a dark shaft, pale jade veins glowing faintly in the rock, drifting motes of light. Light: yellow lamplight from the right and cool jade-green light from below meeting on her cheek in a soft pale blend, cool spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a faint pale-gold and white shimmer of light and metal qi gathers round the lamp flame. Expression: patient, devout, humble: a woman who failed the Level Beam by five and keeps looking at the light.

people.imagined: The charcoal village in daylight, her eyes wide against the glare; a woman in red has promised to come back and teach her. The soot in her knuckles never washes out.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a pale daylight yard she shades her widened eyes with a hand, blinking in the glare. Face: most important, the wide eyes: unusually large, very dark pupils that fill her eyes almost entirely in the daylight, and soot in every crease of the hand shading them. A thin, small, pale face; smudged cheekbones; faint brows; a small nose; a quiet, hopeful mouth. A little ash dusts one cheekbone. Hair: black, tied in a plain braid with a scrap of red silk ribbon, short wisps escaping at her ears and temples. Body: slight, thin, upright, shoulders drawn up, feet together, shy and watchful. Clothing: a young mortal girl's clean, simple, graceful dress: a soft grey silk-cotton robe with a single crossed collar of pale grey, sleeves rolled, mended neatly at the hem with a thread of red, a small embroidered border of tiny flames in dark thread, a plain sash, bare feet in wooden clogs. Hands and objects: the soot-creased hand, soot dark in each knuckle crease like pencil lines; a wicker basket of shiny black charcoal at her feet, one lump broken to show a silver grain. Background: a bright yard with a smoking kiln dome and ash-grey trees in soft haze, motes of pale light. Light: bright pearly overcast spirit-light from the upper left, the shadows under her feet deeper than they should be, pooling like spilled ink. Power: a faint dark-violet wisp of shadow qi gathers at her feet. Expression: a quiet, wondering, hopeful trust, the wide dark eyes lifted to the glare.

people.imagined: The old chief of the Bobtail robbers, who raised two nobodies' sons and hafted an axe in lynx bone for each. A memorial portrait showing him at the ridge fire, an old axe on his knee.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; an old man sits on a ridge by a fire, an axe across his lap. Face: most important, the two axes: two woodsmen's axes with pale lynx-bone hafts, one in his hands and one laid beside him, matching. A broad, kind, battered, weathered face; steady, gentle, dark eyes; thick white brows; a broken nose; a short white beard; a small smile. Hair: white, long, tied back under a lynx-fur cap with a tail and a silver ring. Body: broad, bulky, strong, sitting heavily, shoulders rounded, knees wide apart, settled. Clothing: the dignified robes of a late chief of a robber camp, rich in the old way: a long over-robe of deep brown brocade with a collar of lynx fur and a border of embroidered pine boughs in gold-brown thread, two inner collars of cream and grey silk, wide sleeves, a broad sash hung with a jade pendant, fur-lined gloves. Hands and objects: the two axes, each with a haft of pale yellow-white lynx shin bone and a notch cut at the butt, the blades dull dark iron with a faint chip near the edge. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a faint orange firelight and the shapes of pines, drifting faint motes. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left, dark vignette, the faded orange firelight tinting the lower half of his white beard the colour of old ivory. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi, softened by the fade, curls round the axe hafts. Expression: brave, generous, just: the quiet smile of a man who raised two nobodies' sons.

people.imagined: 1171, the fire hall's door at Băng Hỏa Môn. A memorial portrait of the seal-cutter's boy turned digger, with a borrowed fire talisman held up and the ward's heat catching his coat.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a lean man stands holding a small square talisman of red paper before his chest. Face: most important, the red talisman: a square of bright red paper, the only strong colour, in his raised hand, with abstract gold strokes (not letters). A lean, eager, sun-browned face; bright, fearless, dark eyes; thick black brows; a wide mouth in a determined grin; a short beard. Hair: black, tied in a tail under a fur cap with a silver pin. Body: lean, wiry, leaning slightly forward, weight on the balls of his feet, chest forward, as if just about to step through a door. Clothing: the robes of a seal-cutter turned ruin-digger, graceful and clean: a long over-robe of deep sea-blue silk with a quilted silk collar and a border of embroidered flames and snow-crystals in silver and red thread, a second collar of white silk, sleeves bound at the wrist, a sash with small carving knives and a seal-cutter's chisel hung beside a jade pendant. Hands and objects: the red talisman in the right hand, its gold strokes swirling abstract lines, nothing like writing; a small chisel with a short bone handle polished by use in the left. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a faint orange glow behind him, drifting faint motes. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, a hint of warm red at the paper tinting his chin and the fur of his collar with a faint pink glow, dark vignette. Power: a faint hot red wisp of fire qi, softened by the fade, curls from the talisman. Expression: brave, impatient, gregarious: the grin of a man about to force a door.

people.imagined: 1194, the sandstorm. A memorial portrait of the salt-boiler's son who felt nothing at the Frost Test three winters running and guarded salt caravans; he sits calm on a salt sack.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a quiet caravan guard sits on a sack of salt with his hands on his knees. Face: most important, the white salt dust: a fine pale dusting of white salt crystals on his dark hair, brows and shoulders, big and plain. A broad, plain, brown, kind face; calm, patient, dark eyes; thick straight brows; a flat nose; a mild, closed mouth; lines at the eyes. Hair: black, in a short tail under a pale silk head-cloth. Body: solid, broad, steady, sitting with his back straight and his shoulders relaxed, the posture of a man at peace. Clothing: a modest mortal guard's clean, graceful robes: a long robe of sand-coloured silk with two crossed collars of cream and pale gold, a vest of dark brown brocade, a border of small embroidered salt-crystals and ripples in silver thread, a plain undyed silk sash tied at the waist, a scarf pulled down from the mouth. Hands and objects: both hands resting open on his knees; a short curved sword in a plain brown scabbard with no ornament at his hip; the salt sack of rough hemp split along one seam, a trickle of white crystals spilling. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, faint wind-driven sand, drifting faint motes. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, dark vignette, a pale dust in the air catching the light like fine snow falling sideways. Power: a faint blue wisp of water qi, softened by the fade, hangs about the salt. Expression: patient, content, honest: a man at peace with a test he failed three winters running.
